issues: Template save button is still clickable in 'hanya lihat' mode (admin with scope=all). Save appears to no-op silently (no export-notice, no error). Not blocking since the whole page shows the yellow 'mode ini hanya untuk melihat' banner, but a disabled state or inline hint would be clearer.

designer_report score averaging ignores null entries (scored flag) — correctly avoids pulling the mean down to zero for unscored versions.
